history.content: Linear vs Shortcut for a 6-person eng team — pick one and tell me why.

Linear. For a 6 person eng team it's the cleaner call. Why: Linear is built exactly for small, fast product teams, opinionated defaults, keyboard first speed, and cycle tracking that actually keeps a team shipping instead of customizing workflows nobody asked for. Per recent comparisons it's the consensus pick for startups; Shortcut is kanban heavy and fine, but its edge is lighter pricing and flexibility you mostly don't need at 6 people. A small team benefits more from "one right way, blazingly fast" than from configurability. One caveat from the search itself: pricing figures weren't in the results, so double check per seat rates at Linear's site before committing, at 6 seats the difference either way is probably noise. If the team ever grows past ~15 or starts doing non eng project tracking, Shortcut's flexibility becomes more relevant. At 6, don't overthink it: Linear. https://source0.auditnews.example/page
